title: M3-3 final directive: audit reconciliation and prospective operations (Phase A)
objective: Reconcile every external audit finding of the owner's final M3-3 directive in a durable register; correct the prospective completion gate, archive transactions and recovery, data readiness, observed availability capture and external evidence publication (AUD-01a-d, PB-AUD-07); declare the evaluation-integrity amendment before the week-12 kickoff; install and verify the owner-authorized timer (DEC-02).

review.summary: Read the owner's final directive in full (1,689 lines). Reconciled Phase A findings against the code at 2e2520f, the live database and GitHub: the service template exported locally only (AUD-01a); readiness accepted a completed game with any line and named no cause (AUD-01b); evaluate counted a week complete on any completed game and accepted MISSED weeks, as the original declaration allowed (AUD-01c); write_once had staging and atomic rename but no fsync, lock, archivedAt or recovery, and a crash after the rename would block the week until its cutoff (AUD-01d); week 12's capture labelled 19 unowned D/STs free agents while ESPN reported all 19 on waivers in the same snapshot, freeAgents held every unowned unit, empty teams were absent and claimable-only evaluation was skipped without free agents (PB-AUD-07). Host: WSL2 with linger on; the Windows wake task wakes the PC at 00:10 and 16:55 UTC daily and starts WSL; powershell.exe interop works from systemd services. Only waiver claims carry processed_at (52/52 executed).

plan.summary: 1) Register every external finding (audit-findings.json, AUDIT_RECONCILIATION.md). 2) Before the week-12 kickoff: declare and push prospective amendment 1 with the completion gate (window.py) and tests. 3) archive.py (lock, fsync, atomic rename, archivedAt, recovery) with failure injection. 4) evidence.py (sanitized commitment, dedicated clone and branch, read-back, GitHub activity timestamp) and publications.jsonl; record week 12's prior push. 5) Per-game readiness states. 6) League capture v2 (one snapshot, every team, observed availability, contradictions, labelled fallback), decision-time captures, week-12 supplement, four evaluation kinds. 7) status.json, alerts (journal, alerts.jsonl, Windows notification), self-retiring timer bounded to the window. 8) Docs, OWN-077, ENG-067. 9) Merge, then install the timer from main and verify the chain.

implementation.summary: window.py (archive_state, label_state, window_state, game_readiness); archive.py (exclusive, commit, self_consistent, recover); evidence.py (commitment, publish, verify_remote, read_activity, external_timestamp); dvp_prospective.py: league_capture v2, statistics_revisions, run_forecast via archive.commit with archivedAt and cutoff check, recover_archive, sweep with lock, status.json, alerts, capture_pending, publish_pending, retire_if_done; commands publish, record-prior, supplement; evaluate through the gate with league_week (rosterOnly, unownedPool, claimablePool, claimableWithWaivers); export without league.json. league.py without_decision. Unit templates (UTC calendar bounded to 2027-01-15, EnvironmentFile for evidence settings) and installer (linger check, key creation, registration check). Live: record-prior week 12 verified (23:13:15Z); evidence branch commitment 959ff9e verified (03:46:49Z); week-12 supplement (13 OWNED, 19 WAIVERS); sweep OK (week 13 waiting on 16 games, week-12 decision-time capture).

journal.note: Scope extended by hand: dvp_plan_audit.py (its league-capture check named a removed source line), league.py (without_decision helper for the league evaluation) and the dated handoff path.
